guard_streams.source: Comparing customer service: choosing the best home broadband, mobile and landline provider

facts.detail: Ofcom last updated the customer-service comparison page on 25 May 2026.
The publication is Ofcom's eighth report comparing residential telecoms customer-service levels.
The report covers residential customer experiences in 2024 and compares results with 2022 and/or 2023.
Ofcom moved the customer-service comparison to biennial reporting after the 2023 edition.
Certain EE broadband and landline fault data for 2024 are subject to restatement after an April 2026 resubmission.

facts.detail: The official-statistics announcement was published on 23 June 2026.
The release date is listed as August 2026 and provisional.
The release will provide breakdowns of UK premises receiving gigabit-capable broadband coverage.
The announced measure is coverage received as a result of BDUK subsidy.
The announcement is issued by Building Digital UK and the Department for Science, Innovation and Technology.

guard_streams.source: Project Gigabit National Rolling Open Market Review January 2026

facts.detail: BDUK published the January 2026 National Rolling Open Market Review on 6 January 2026.
The consultation page was last updated on 10 June 2026.
The page records the formal closure of the January 2026 review and outlines next steps.
The review seeks evidence of current gigabit infrastructure and supplier plans for the next three years.
BDUK states that National Rolling OMR exercises take place in January, May and September.

facts.detail: Ofcom last updated the infrastructure-reports collection on 27 May 2026.
The collection focuses on coverage and performance of fixed-broadband and mobile networks.
Ofcom publishes an annual Connected Nations report on UK communications infrastructure.
The collection describes two annual updates: a coverage update and a planned-deployment update.
The 2026 entries include a January 2026 coverage snapshot and planned deployment projections through the end of 2028.
